purpose: Make each mobility scenario readable as a bounded service contract before any pilot request.
purpose_zh: 把每个交通场景写成申请试点前可读、可追问的服务合同。
boundary: All ten cards are not_authorized_not_run. They contain design roles and evidence requests, not confirmed partners, permits, resident findings, fleet capacity or field outcomes.

cards.space_zh: 众智园入口—轨道站口—路缘窗口
cards.space_en: Zhongzhiyuan entrance — rail stop — curb window
cards.users_zh: 企业员工；受路缘变化影响的居民
cards.users_en: Enterprise employees; residents affected by curb changes
cards.trigger_zh: 工作日早高峰出现两个以上企业聚合需求时段
cards.trigger_en: A weekday AM peak with at least two grouped enterprise demand windows
cards.inputs_zh: 15 分钟分组需求、车队与站点、消防净空、居民异议台账
cards.inputs_en: 15-minute grouped demand, fleet and stops, fire clearance, resident objection log
cards.service_action_zh: 比较合并班车、地铁/公交、骑行和步行的接驳组合
cards.service_action_en: Compare a merged shuttle with metro/bus, bicycle and walking connections
cards.readout_zh: 方式份额、站口负荷、路缘冲突、投诉首响
cards.readout_en: Mode share, station load, curb conflict and complaint first response
cards.accountable_role_zh: 企业交通协调；轨道公交；现场维护
cards.fallback_zh: 保留公共交通和人工回家服务，不开共享预约
cards.fallback_en: Keep public transport and human return-home service; do not open shared booking
cards.stop_condition_zh: 需求未日期化、无运营接管人或居民冲突无法回读
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without dated demand, an accountable operator or a reviewable resident-conflict record

cards.space_zh: 企业入口—地铁/公交换乘界面
cards.users_zh: 企业员工；低汽车依赖员工；无障碍出行者
cards.users_en: Enterprise employees; low-car travellers; accessible-travel users
cards.trigger_zh: 企业提出分组方式基线和可退出的补贴试验
cards.trigger_en: An enterprise proposes a grouped mode baseline and an opt-out benefit test
cards.inputs_zh: 方式份额、票制、无障碍入口、员工同意与退出方式
cards.inputs_en: Mode share, fare rules, accessibility entry, employee consent and opt-out route
cards.service_action_zh: 并列比较补贴、人工咨询、电话和纸面入口，不把研究效果当成本地转移
cards.service_action_en: Compare the benefit with human, telephone and paper access without importing research effects as local shift
cards.readout_zh: 分组方式变化、非数字入口使用、等待与拒绝率
cards.readout_en: Grouped mode change, non-digital access, waiting and refusal rate
cards.accountable_role_zh: 企业交通协调；轨道公交；隐私安全复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Enterprise mobility; rail/bus; privacy and safety review
cards.fallback_zh: 不启用补贴试验，保留普通票务和人工窗口
cards.fallback_en: Do not start the benefit test; retain ordinary fare and human-desk access
cards.stop_condition_zh: 无员工退出、票制、分组基线或无障碍等价入口
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without opt-out, fare, grouped baseline or equivalent accessibility entry

cards.space_zh: 企业入口—夜间站点—社区服务台
cards.space_en: Enterprise entrance — night stop — community service desk
cards.users_zh: 夜班员工；晚间照护者；夜间维护人员
cards.users_en: Night workers; evening carers; night maintenance staff
cards.trigger_zh: 夜间班次出现有日期的分组回家需求
cards.trigger_en: A dated grouped return-home demand appears for a night shift
cards.inputs_zh: 需求区间、值守电话、接管人、安全等候点和地面回家路线
cards.inputs_en: Demand range, staffed phone, takeover person, safe waiting point and ground route home
cards.service_action_zh: 先给轨道公交和人工电话入口，再评估低速接驳缺口
cards.service_action_en: Start with rail/bus and a human phone entry, then assess any low-speed feeder gap
cards.readout_zh: 接通率、等候时长、人工接管率、路线完成
cards.readout_en: Answer rate, waiting time, human takeover rate and route completion
cards.accountable_role_zh: 企业交通协调；社区服务；现场维护
cards.accountable_role_en: Enterprise mobility; community service; field maintenance
cards.fallback_zh: 没有真人接电话就停在调查，不开启预约
cards.fallback_en: Remain in investigation if no person can answer; do not open booking
cards.stop_condition_zh: 无值守电话、等候点、安全复核或返程安排
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without a staffed phone, waiting point, safety review or return plan

cards.space_zh: 企业入口—服务路缘—消防通道
cards.space_en: Enterprise entrance — service curb — fire route
cards.users_zh: 物流与维护人员；居民；应急响应者
cards.users_en: Logistics and maintenance staff; residents; emergency responders
cards.trigger_zh: 服务车辆需要短时装卸且不应占用公共连续路线
cards.trigger_en: A service vehicle needs a short loading window without occupying the public continuous route
cards.inputs_zh: 车型、路缘责任、清场时限、消防和无障碍绕行
cards.inputs_en: Vehicle class, curb owner, clearance deadline, fire and accessibility detour
cards.service_action_zh: 把服务路缘变成有责任人和结束时刻的短时窗口
cards.service_action_en: Make service curb a short window with an owner and a clear end time
cards.readout_zh: 按时清场、消防净空、无障碍绕行、居民投诉
cards.readout_en: On-time clearance, fire clearance, accessible detour and resident complaints
cards.accountable_role_zh: 企业交通协调；现场维护；交通无障碍复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Enterprise mobility; field maintenance; accessibility review
cards.fallback_zh: 只登记装卸，不锁定公共路缘
cards.fallback_en: Record loading only; do not reserve public curb
cards.stop_condition_zh: 责任边界、清场证据或消防/无障碍绕行缺失
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without ownership, clearance evidence or fire/accessibility detour

cards.space_zh: AI 原点社区—社区服务台—医院方向换乘
cards.space_en: AI Origin community — community desk — hospital-direction transfer
cards.users_zh: 居民；照护者；儿童；老年人
cards.trigger_zh: 居民按服务类型提出有回程安排的就医需求
cards.trigger_en: Residents request a care trip by service type with a return plan
cards.inputs_zh: 聚合服务类型、人工/电话/纸面入口、照护规则和回程安排
cards.inputs_en: Grouped service type, human/telephone/paper entry, care rule and return plan
cards.service_action_zh: 把 AI 推荐和人工等价路线并列，基本通行不要求 App
cards.service_action_en: Place AI and equivalent human routes side by side; do not require an app for basic access
cards.readout_zh: 路线完成、等待、拒绝、照护回程连续性
cards.readout_en: Route completion, waiting, refusal and continuity of the care return trip
cards.accountable_role_zh: 社区服务；居民照护观察；无障碍复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Community service; resident/carer observation; accessibility review
cards.fallback_zh: 保留普通公共交通和人工窗口，不要求注册
cards.fallback_en: Keep ordinary public transport and a human desk; do not require registration
cards.stop_condition_zh: 无非数字入口、回程安排或隐私最小化规则
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without non-digital access, a return plan or data minimisation

cards.space_zh: 社区—站口—公共服务点连续人行线
cards.space_en: Community — station — public-service continuous walking line
cards.users_zh: 轮椅使用者；助行器使用者；照护者
cards.trigger_zh: 任何推荐路线涉及坡道、电梯、过街或天气变化
cards.trigger_en: A recommended route involves ramps, lifts, crossings or weather change
cards.inputs_zh: 连续路线走查、电梯/坡道状态、过街、坡度和天气回退
cards.inputs_en: Continuous route audit, lift/ramp status, crossings, gradients and weather fallback
cards.service_action_zh: 先验证等价地面路线，再允许任何数字推荐进入候选
cards.service_action_en: Verify an equivalent ground route before any digital recommendation becomes eligible
cards.readout_zh: 路线完成率、断点数、绕行时间、人工协助需求
cards.readout_en: Route completion, breaks, detour time and human-assistance demand
cards.accountable_role_zh: 交通无障碍复核；现场维护；居民照护观察
cards.accountable_role_en: Accessibility review; field maintenance; resident/carer observation
cards.fallback_zh: 任一段没有等价回退就关闭推荐
cards.fallback_en: Close the recommendation if any segment lacks an equivalent fallback
cards.stop_condition_zh: 电梯、坡道、过街或天气回退未被日期化核验
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without dated verification of lifts, ramps, crossings or weather fallback

cards.space_zh: 大钟寺站口—骑行停放—企业/居民入口
cards.space_en: Dazhongsi station entrance — bicycle parking — enterprise/resident entries
cards.users_zh: 轨道通勤者；居民；访客；无障碍出行者
cards.users_en: Rail commuters; residents; visitors; accessible-travel users
cards.trigger_zh: 站口换乘和最后一段出现可计数的时段压力
cards.trigger_en: The station entrance and last leg show a countable time-window pressure
cards.inputs_zh: 站口/换乘计数、最后一段审计、骑行停放和时段基线
cards.inputs_en: Station/transfer counts, last-leg audit, bicycle parking and time baseline
cards.service_action_zh: 把地铁、公交、骑行、步行和无障碍接驳放在同一站口账本里
cards.service_action_en: Place metro, bus, bicycle, walking and accessible connections in one station ledger
cards.readout_zh: 换乘可靠、站口负荷、停放占用、无障碍完成
cards.readout_en: Transfer reliability, station load, parking occupancy and accessibility completion
cards.accountable_role_zh: 轨道公交；交通无障碍；现场维护
cards.fallback_zh: 不以合成时间替代站口和路段计数，维持地面公共交通
cards.fallback_en: Do not substitute synthetic time for station/street counts; keep ground public transport
cards.stop_condition_zh: 无站口、路段、停放和无障碍基线
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without station, street, parking and accessibility baselines

cards.space_zh: 公共空间—站口—物流与应急通道
cards.space_en: Public space — station entrance — logistics and emergency routes
cards.users_zh: 居民；访客；物流维护；应急响应者
cards.trigger_zh: 活动日人数范围和居民回家需求都能先行登记
cards.trigger_en: An event-day attendance range and resident return demand can both be registered
cards.inputs_zh: 活动人数、居民回家、物流/应急路线和清场责任
cards.inputs_en: Attendance range, resident return, logistics/emergency routes and clearance owner
cards.service_action_zh: 按时段分开人行、服务、接驳与应急动线，不封死公共连续路线
cards.service_action_en: Separate walking, service, feeder and emergency flows by time without closing the public route
cards.readout_zh: 应急连续、清场准时、居民回家、冲突事件
cards.readout_en: Emergency continuity, on-time clearance, resident return and conflict events
cards.accountable_role_zh: 社区服务；交通安全；现场维护；独立复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Community service; traffic safety; field maintenance; independent review
cards.fallback_zh: 应急通道不能连续就缩小或取消演练
cards.fallback_en: Reduce or cancel the rehearsal if emergency access is not continuous
cards.stop_condition_zh: 活动范围、疏散路线或清场责任不明确
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without a defined event range, evacuation route or clearance owner

cards.space_zh: 全环路网；重点关注无障碍与公共交通回退
cards.space_en: Whole mobility loop, with accessible and public-transport fallback priority
cards.users_zh: 所有出行者；轮椅使用者；夜班人员；维护人员
cards.users_en: All travellers; wheelchair users; night workers; maintenance staff
cards.trigger_zh: 发生天气、通信或轨道中断事件
cards.trigger_en: A weather, communications or rail disruption occurs
cards.inputs_zh: 有日期的中断情景、人工接管名单、地面回退路线和复盘记录
cards.inputs_en: Dated disruption cases, manual takeover list, ground route and replay record
cards.service_action_zh: 冻结预约，切回人工、地面公共交通和连续无障碍路线
cards.service_action_en: Freeze bookings and return to human service, ground transit and continuous accessible routes
cards.readout_zh: 回退覆盖、最慢群体、恢复时间代理、未满足需求
cards.readout_en: Fallback coverage, slowest group, recovery-time proxy and unmet demand
cards.accountable_role_zh: 轨道公交；现场维护；独立安全隐私复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Rail/bus; field maintenance; independent safety/privacy review
cards.fallback_zh: AI 不可用时回到人工和地面公共交通
cards.fallback_en: Return to human and ground public transport when AI is unavailable
cards.stop_condition_zh: 无人工接管、回退路线或事件复盘记录
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without human takeover, a fallback route or an incident replay record

cards.space_zh: 社区服务台—企业交通台—路缘资产
cards.space_en: Community desk — enterprise mobility desk — curb assets
cards.users_zh: 居民；企业；维护人员；无障碍出行者
cards.users_en: Residents; enterprises; maintenance staff; accessible-travel users
cards.trigger_zh: 发生投诉、路缘故障、无障碍断点或服务拒绝
cards.trigger_en: A complaint, curb fault, accessibility break or service refusal is recorded
cards.inputs_zh: 公开投诉入口、受理人、响应时限、维修记录和独立复核日期
cards.inputs_en: Public complaint entry, owner, response SLA, repair log and independent review date
cards.service_action_zh: 记录问题、暂时回退、维修、回应和是否恢复，形成可读台账
cards.service_action_en: Record the problem, temporary fallback, repair, response and restoration in a readable ledger
cards.readout_zh: 首响、关闭、重开、维修和意见回应状态
cards.readout_en: First response, closure, reopening, repair and response-to-objection status
cards.accountable_role_zh: 社区服务；现场维护；独立复核
cards.accountable_role_en: Community service; field maintenance; independent review
cards.fallback_zh: 没有责任人和状态更新就不算关闭，服务回到人工入口
cards.fallback_en: Do not call it closed without an owner and status update; return service to the human entry
cards.stop_condition_zh: 投诉入口、责任人、时间戳或回应证据缺失
cards.stop_condition_en: Stop without a complaint entry, owner, timestamp or response evidence
